connector.name: htmlweb.ru - справочники и проверки для AI
connector.registryDescription: RU INN/OGRN, banks, geo, WHOIS. Agent self-registers via register_agent. 20 free/day.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.htmlweb.ru over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ru.htmlweb, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
